Name: Just Turn Flower into Honey
Author: HRG164hjo
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is my first mod for Stardew Valley.
I don't prefer bee houses, so I made this.[/color]
Just place a flower into dehydrator, and the flower will turn into honey.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher.

[/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]Note[/color][/b][color=#D4D4D8]
I'm new to Stardew Valley modding, so this mod may have compatibility issues in large mod lists. If there's one, I'll try my best to fix it.[/color]
